_brief: Batch 2026-10-03 item 5, GIVING WATER TO WORKERS - Tal's re-brief (LESSONS 79): 'all the water videos, just no sound, like just do a compilation all into one video, of all the shots.' Replaces ek-water-1..4 (left untouched). ONE silent compilation: every worker in the folder, give -> drink/hug/smile -> hard cut to the next person. LESSONS 80 ('stop with all the zooms its weird'): NO zoom movement - every beat has a constant crop z:[a,a], one framing per take, contiguous beats of a take share it exactly, no wide-then-tight on the same take; slow motion and hard cuts stay. NO SOUND: the timeline is a digitally silent bed (silence.wav, bedOnly) with every beat's own audio muted; silent:true so no captions. Order (COMPILATION-ORDER): fence crew (open on the handoff, smiles in frame 0) -> Omar at the market -> promenade cleaner (the hug, 3rd) -> Sri Lanka crew -> the Old City man (ends on his hand on his heart, held in slow-mo). The two construction crews and the two older bald men are never adjacent. Each person 3.1-5.1s. Left out: Aram (IMG_1239, back to camera for all 39s, operator's hand + can in frame); IMG_8609 (false start, only Tal on the curb); the fence clip 6-46s (distant wide, faces too small at 360p); the second Sri Lanka worker's smile at POV 57.25 (same moment as the wide high five - one action, one shot). Passers-by checked on frames: cars at fence 6.0-7.1/9.0-9.8, runner at the promenade ~4.5-4.7, woman ~6.5-7.8, jogger ~10.4 at the left edge - all outside the beats/crops. Grade off.
